primary_endpoint: For each frozen exact-domain rule, the sealed-test LR+ lower 95% bound exceeds 1 after Holm family-wise correction and every sample-size, source, laboratory, formula, metadata, isolation, and interval-width gate passes.
analysis_unit: one two-dimensional molecular connectivity identity per exact acquisition stratum
replication_rule: technical scans and mirror copies collapse first by acquisition_replication_group_id; peak content cannot create a new experimental replicate
background_definition: all eligible non-target identities in the identical exact acquisition stratum

splitting.infeasible_action: stop before rule discovery and report an origin-isolation failure

confidence_intervals.reported_interval: union of analytic and cluster-bootstrap 95% intervals

collision_energy.fixed_settings_at_least_four: natural cubic spline with three degrees of freedom when at least 20 identities are shared
collision_energy.sparse_fixed_settings: five-native-unit bins; each bin must independently pass every primary threshold
collision_energy.composite_program: retain the full vector and weights; no midpoint substitution
collision_energy.mse_bbcid_all_ions: positive evidence only after verified deconvolution; no LR-

evidence_grades.G0: metadata unavailable; no quantitative likelihood ratio
evidence_grades.G4: sealed-test validated LR+ and LR- class support
